title: Fable mock model (Peek, clay source)
description: A low-fi model of one highlighted thing, built from primitives by the client (ClayBuilder.cs). Parts form a tree through 'parent'. Positions, sizes and offsets are in the model's own units; the client scales the whole model so its tallest extent is heightMetres. The triangle cost of each shape is fixed (see 'triangles' below) and the total must stay under 15000. Labels are short notes written by Claude, each pinned to a part; 2 to 5 of them.

title.description: what the model shows: 'the golden key'

sentenceId.description: the last sentence the generator was shown; the model may not show anything the book reveals after it

heightMetres.description: displayed size of the tallest extent, beside the page

realHeight.description: the thing's size in the story, for the caption: 'about 6 cm', 'nine feet'

source.description: clay: written by the interpreter (Claude via fable-interpreter); fixture: written by hand for tests and the offline library

parent.description: id of an earlier part; position and rotation are then relative to it

size.description: extent along x, y, z. torus: x and z are the outer diameter, y the tube thickness

rotation.description: Euler degrees, applied z, x, y (Unity order)

part.description: id of the part the label's line points at

quote.description: true when the text quotes the book (it must then appear at or before sentenceId)

triangles.description: Triangle cost per shape, shared by the validator (interpreter/internal/mock) and the client builder (ClayBuilder.cs).
